edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument of _transfer from transfer/transferFrom.
block.timestamp is compared with and written into cooldown[to], making the anti-bot gate timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
onlyOwner modifier requires _owner == _msgSender() before setCooldownEnabled executes.
onlyOwner modifier gates blacklistBots.
onlyOwner modifier gates delBot.
onlyOwner modifier gates removeStrictTxLimit.
onlyOwner modifier gates openTrading and the use of owner() as liquidity recipient.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the destination of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the destination of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
uniswapV2Router is the external contract invoked by the swap call.
uniswapV2Router receives the addLiquidityETH call.
uniswapV2Router.factory() is called to obtain the factory for createPair.
uniswapV2Pair is the token contract approved to the router.
_maxTxAmount is enforced by require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) in _transfer.
the bots mapping is read to reject blacklisted senders/recipients.
the cooldown mapping is read and written with the 30 second delay.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-fee block in _transfer.
inSwap prevents nested swap execution inside _transfer.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown branch in _transfer.
_rOwned balances for sender, recipient and the contract are rewritten in _transferStandard.
_rTotal feeds the rate computation used by _transferStandard.
_feeAddr1 is supplied as the tax fee to _getValues/_getTValues.
_feeAddr2 is supplied as the team fee to _getValues/_getTValues.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not in a swap.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_transfer reaches _transferStandard through _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to wallet 1.
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to wallet 2.
openTrading calls the factory to create the pair.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading approves the router to spend the LP pair tokens.
manualswap delegates to swapTokensForEth for the whole contract balance.
manualsend delegates to sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
transferFrom calls _transfer before decrementing the allowance.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team token amount.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection and token fees.
_transferStandard obtains its amounts from _getValues.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned[address(this)] with the team reflection amount.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert the team tokens to reflections.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-denominated amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-denominated amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current conversion rate.
_getRValues receives the rate produced by _getRate.
_getRate divides the supplies returned by _getCurrentSupply.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
tokenFromReflection reads _rOwned[account] to derive the token balance.

The external Uniswap swap pulls token balances back through this contract while _transferStandard has not yet updated _rOwned, so a callback can re-enter the transfer path before balances settle (partially mitigated by lockTheSwap on the swap branch).
addLiquidityETH in openTrading executes while tradingOpen is still false but the router interacts with this token, allowing re-entry into _transfer before all flags and balances are set.
